case_convention: Positive means an observed violation; negative means evaluated without violation; unavailable means abstention, never a negative.

reliability.applicability: Recognized source-syntax rules; both configured-rule counting and the CLI reliability gate select non-advisory production findings. Test/advisory rows remain outside this policy selection.
reliability.scope: Configured source roots; source spans, test/production classification and rule-specific syntax matching, not a compiled safety proof.
reliability.rationale: Identify explicit failure and unsafe-code maintenance risks without interpreting unknown scope as zero.
limitations: Per-rule language/version profiles and detection corpora remain incomplete
Unexpanded and conditional source ownership remains subject to semantic abstention
No proof that unwrap panics or unsafe code is unsound
reliability.case_coverage: Partial: unwrap corpus and gate unavailability, not every detection rule

test-quality.applicability: Syntactically discovered test functions; configured rule limits only.
test-quality.scope: Ignored-test annotations and observed assertion/subject-call syntax in the configured test scope.
test-quality.rationale: Make missing test intent evidence reviewable without treating heuristics as proof of ineffective tests.
limitations: Indirect assertions and custom harnesses can escape syntax recognition
No exhaustive per-rule positive/negative/unavailable certification

prerequisites: At least one explicitly required behavior
Resolved owners need attributable current execution
testing-ownership.applicability: Only manifest behaviors with required = true and an explicit configured rule limit; test-value advice is never enforced.
testing-ownership.scope: Exact package/target/path/qualified-name selectors in the recorded Cargo scope; not all environments declared in prose.
testing-ownership.rationale: Enforce explicit retained-owner obligations without rewarding test counts or inferred value.
limitations: Declarations do not prove behavioral adequacy or boundary realism
Duplicate execution names and skipped/stale/unexecuted owners abstain
External harnesses are unresolved; deletion and sensitivity advice remain non-blocking
testing-ownership.case_coverage: Scoped real CLI ownership and reporter journey; not global detector certification

prerequisites: A matching check with status passed or failed
Enabled backend and its declared tool/configuration/dependency inputs
practices.applicability: Official cargo checks plus explicitly enabled optional tools and project metadata checks. Skipped or absent checks do not establish a negative.
practices.scope: The recorded command, verification workspace/target/features configuration, or named project metadata field/file; not all possible configurations.
practices.rationale: Use observed execution or metadata evidence instead of assuming installed/enabled tools or successful execution.
limitations: Tool-specific prerequisites and version applicability still require individual rule contracts
Project metadata presence does not establish content quality
Compiler diagnostic rule enablement is not inferred from an empty diagnostic list
practices.case_coverage: Pending per-rule cases; policy ingestion cases are separate from backend certification

prerequisites: Matching enabled architecture rule in effective configuration
architecture.applicability: Exact configured architecture rule IDs, not guessed namespaces.
architecture.scope: Configured layer/boundary graph constraints and their declared exclusions.
architecture.rationale: Enforce explicit dependency boundaries using the graph actually observed.
limitations: Incomplete semantic edges require abstention
Configuration-specific positive/negative/unavailable cases remain to be certified

prerequisites: Proof of rule enablement for the declared command/version/scope
rust.compiler.* / rust.clippy.*.applicability: Diagnostic observations are retained, but an arbitrary diagnostic rule cannot be certified from its absence.
rust.compiler.* / rust.clippy.*.rationale: Prevent an unsupported or disabled lint from becoming a clean configured rule.
limitations: Shared practice projection preserves observed diagnostics and invocation context but does not establish compatible engine scopes
Per-rule negative coverage is unavailable
rust.compiler.* / rust.clippy.*.case_coverage: Projection cases only; unsupported for complete configured-rule evaluation

prerequisites: Explicit producer version, evaluated rules, applicability and exclusion scope
external.<adapter>.<rule>.applicability: Imported observations are retained; an empty imported report does not prove that an arbitrary rule ran.
external.<adapter>.<rule>.scope: Imported producer scope, not an inferred union of engine scopes.
external.<adapter>.<rule>.rationale: Preserve external observations without inventing negative coverage or engine agreement.
limitations: Current external format does not establish per-rule negative coverage
Corroboration/disagreement/exclusion projection remains open

prerequisites: All four native finding artifacts when any configured rule has error level
Rule-specific coverage from the families above
configured-rules.scope: Active findings after waivers and path/package exclusions, within each producer's selection scope
configured-rules.rationale: Enforce declared counts only when their evaluation is supported and complete
limitations: Unknown, compiler-diagnostic and external rule coverage abstains
Family contracts are not exhaustive per-rule detector certification

prerequisites: architecture_rules.json when an architecture rule has error level
architecture-rules.rationale: Apply configured boundaries independently of CLI fail-on flags
limitations: Graph completeness is required
Full configured-rule case certification is pending

prerequisites: Imported source-linked reports for required external adapters
external-evidence.scope: External report ingestion and freshness, not per-rule negative coverage
external-evidence.rationale: Reject absent or unusable imported evidence
limitations: A current report is not proof that every external rule ran
E6 scope/corroboration semantics remain open

partial.scope: Default producer inventory, excluding opt-in source-expansion
limitations: Completeness is scoped, not a compiled whole-program proof

prerequisites: Observed successful run and no unknown test statuses
limitations: Passing tests do not prove correctness

practice-failure.scope: Enabled practice checks and blocking dispositions
limitations: Optional skipped checks are not certified

reliability-finding.scope: Non-advisory production findings with blocking disposition
limitations: Not a proof of runtime failure

operational-failure.rationale: Reject breached budgets or absent/expired observations
limitations: No inference beyond the measured window
Score is not a calibrated defect or effort probability

prerequisites: Coverage/performance evidence when present in either side
regression.scope: Compatible current/baseline observations and configured delta limits
regression.rationale: Do not confuse incomparable or disappeared evidence with improvement
limitations: Runtime coverage/performance are execution inputs, not deterministic static measurements
